methodologyNote: Measured via page views across tracked network traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Safari led browsers (mobile) in Oceania at 46.94% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Chrome ranked second at 44.9%, followed by Samsung Internet at 5.79%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in Oceania?
faqs.answer: Safari leads at 46.94% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/oceania.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in Oceania?
faqs.answer: Safari (46.94%), Chrome (44.9%), Samsung Internet (5.79%) in October 2026.
